pages.text: Did you find me, or did I let you? Sit with that a moment.

The Warden points at a great many things.

Here is your first lesson, and it is the only one I will hand over whole: nothing
worth having in Ennara is where it is supposed to be.

Look at the courtyard. Count the paving stones along the north wall. Now count them
again.

Different number, is it not? Good. That is Search. You already knew how -- you had
simply never been told it was allowed.

What a question. What a wonderfully answered-for-you question.

Go and see the sentry at the south gate. Tell her nothing interesting.
Back already. Did you count them again?
